title: Egypt and Ethiopia expel diplomats
gist: A short Al-Monitor 'Middle East Minute' podcast episode headlined on Egypt and Ethiopia expelling diplomats; its description notes the US sent more naval forces to the Middle East and Saudi Arabia accused the Houthis of targeting Medina, which the group denied.

insights.claim: Egypt and Ethiopia have expelled each other's diplomats, according to the headline of an Al-Monitor Middle East Minute episode.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: A diplomatic expulsion signals escalation in Egypt-Ethiopia tensions, raising Horn of Africa and Nile-region political risk; the episode text gives no further detail.

themes.theme: US naval buildup in Middle East

insights.claim: The United States sent additional naval forces to the Middle East.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Additional US naval deployments indicate heightened regional threat perception, relevant to shipping, energy-route and escalation risk.
insights.quote: The US sent more naval forces to the Middle East
insights.locator: The US sent more naval forces

insights.claim: Saudi Arabia accused Yemen's Houthis of targeting the holy city of Medina, an accusation the Houthis denied.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: An alleged Houthi strike on Medina would mark a serious escalation against Saudi territory and religious sites; the denial leaves attribution contested.
insights.quote: Saudi Arabia accused the Houthis of targeting Medina, which the group denied
insights.locator: The US sent more naval forces
